description: Latest block number and block details on zkSync Era, or any block by decimal number: hash, timestamp, transaction count, gas used and limit, base fee in gwei and producer. Use for timestamps and confirmation counts; for current fees use zksync_gas. A block that does not exist yet returns 404, uncharged. Example: number=latest. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: zksync_block
